data.text: **Question:** What is inheritance and why is it used?
Inheritance allows a class to acquire properties and methods from another class, promoting code reuse and establishing hierarchical relationships.
Inheritance creates an 'is-a' relationship. The derived class inherits from the base class. Enables polymorphism and code reuse. Should be used carefully to avoid deep hierarchies.

data.title: Inheritance Example

data.text: Interviewers assess understanding of code reuse, hierarchy design, and when to use composition over inheritance.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use carefully to avoid tight coupling
